# Midway Construction & Dirtwork (MCD)

> One company, every step. A construction and dirtwork outfit that handles a job from the sub-grade to the finish: excavation, utilities, concrete, shop buildings, roads and driveways, and in-ground trampolines. Owner: Pete Baxendale (third-generation owner). Licensed and insured. Free estimates.

- Phone (call or text): 307-254-0578
- Email: pete.midway@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/midwayconstructionanddirtwork
- Service area and common questions: https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/faq

## Services
- [Excavation, sub-grade and site prep](https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/services#excavation)
- [Utility installation: water, sewer and power lines](https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/services#utilities)
- [Foundations and concrete: slabs, power-troweled flatwork, stamped and decorative concrete, raised patios](https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/services#concrete)
- [Metal and wood shop construction, start to finish](https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/services#shops)
- [Roads and driveways](https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/services#roads-driveways)
- [Finish work](https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/services#finish-work)
- [In-ground trampoline installation](https://midway.eaglewebcreation.com/in-ground-trampolines)
